text: You tend to enjoy recipes that feature yeast and whole wheat flour, but this Cinnamon Streusel Blueberry Muffins recipe doesn't include those ingredients. However, it does include baking powder and fresh blueberries, which are also present in liked recipes. The recipe's short preparation time and relatively low calorie count may also appeal to you. While it's not a vegan option, you may consider making modifications to accommodate your dietary preferences.
